limitations: Annual names have no verified correspondence to API route_id; combined routes and special services occur.
Operated sections are not departures or vehicle trips.
The published distance details differ from the total; original numbers are retained.
Corridor passenger trips are not unique people; one trip may involve multiple corridors.
Operated sections are not departures.

limitations: Scores are historical assessment results, not real-time performance.
The 12-operator comparison excludes Tamsui, New Taipei and Royal due to small fleets.
Published rounded component scores may differ slightly from published totals; both are retained.
E3/E4 aggregate results are not arithmetic means of company scores.
The PDF does not identify inspectors; adjacent duplicate station/date columns are separate source observations and must not be deduplicated blindly.
Inspection dates are month/day only; inspection_date remains null and no year is invented.
Blank score cells remain null; the source contains a few scores above the printed weights and these are retained as source anomalies.
These are historical inspection scores, not beds, usable parking capacities, or driver duty records.
Sample survey results do not cover every trip or route.
When the source merges peak and off-peak columns, peak/off_peak values are null and original numbers are stored in unstratified fields; they are not classified as peak samples.
Blank cells in genuinely separate columns remain null, never zero.
Repeated names are distinct source rows; no API route_id has been assigned.
Company/route ratios follow the report method and need not equal ratios of pooled counts.
